question_summary: Request approval to substitute PVC for the specified cast-iron roof drain leader per Spec Section 22 14 00.
proposed_solution: Use a PVC roof drain leader in lieu of the specified cast-iron leader, with equivalent performance data and code-compliance listings.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: As a substitution request affecting plumbing systems without declared cost impact, it should be reviewed by the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer of record.
